title: El gobernador de Morelos, Cuauhtémoc Blanco, toma licencia de su cargo por orden del Tribunal Electoral para hacer válida su candidatura como diputado federal.
text: El Gobernador o gobernadora del Estado Libre y Soberano de Morelos es el titular del poder ejecutivo en el Estado de Morelos, siendo este poder depositado en un solo individuo, según la Constitución del Estado de Morelos. Es electo mediante elección popular y directa para un periodo de seis años no reelegibles en ningún caso, y solo es renunciable por causas graves, aprobadas por el Congreso.

text: La refinería Lázaro Cárdenas del Río, también llamada refinería de Minatitlán, es una refinería de petróleo ubicada en la localidad de Minatitlán en el estado mexicano de Veracruz. Junto a otras cinco refinerías, forma parte del Sistema Nacional de Refinación, propiedad de la empresa paraestatal mexicana Petróleos Mexicanos (PEMEX).

title: El gobierno de Ecuador demanda al gobierno mexicano ante la Corte Penal Internacional por el asilo concedido al exvicepresidente ecuatoriano Jorge Glas.

text: Una ola de calor es un período sostenido de temperatura extremadamente alta para una región determinada. La ola de calor se mide con relación a la temperatura promedio considerada para una determinada región.

text: The Tlatelolco massacre was a military massacre committed by the Mexican Armed Forces against the students of the National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM), the National Polytechnic Institute (IPN) and other universities in Mexico. title: A US federal court sentences Genaro García Luna, the former Secretary of Public Security under President Felipe Calderón, to 38 years' imprisonment for colluding with the Sinaloa Cartel in smuggling illegal drugs into the United States.
text: Genaro García Luna is a Mexican former government official and convicted drug trafficker. From 2006 to 2012, he served as secretary of public security during the administration of Felipe Calderón.

title: Marcelo Pérez Pérez, a Catholic priest and indigenous rights activist working in Chiapas, is shot dead after celebrating Sunday mass in San Cristóbal de las Casas.
text: Marcelo Pérez Pérez was a Mexican diocesan priest and Indigenous rights activist. He was murdered in 2024 on his way to Mass.

title: Nineteen suspected gang members are killed in a shootout with soldiers outside Culiacán that leads to the arrest of a local leader of the Sinaloa Cartel.
text: The Sinaloa Cartel is a fractured Mexican drug trafficking organization and transnational organized crime syndicate based in Culiacán, Sinaloa, Mexico. It specializes in illegal drug trafficking, money laundering, and murder.

title: At least 16 pedestrians are injured in a car ramming in the cathedral square of Guadalajara by a suspect driving a stolen pickup who is arrested.
text: Plaza Guadalajara is an urban square in Centro, Guadalajara, in the Mexican state of Jalisco.

title: Eight of the 11 justices of the Supreme Court of Justice of the Nation, including its president Norma Lucía Piña Hernández, submit their resignations from the court.
text: The Supreme Court of Mexico, formally the Supreme Court of Justice of the Nation is the highest court in Mexico and the apex of the Mexican federal judiciary. Judges of the SCJN are elected for 12 years.

title: The Mexican Tennis Federation cancels its Juniors 30 tournament in Irapuato, Guanajuato, after ten underage players and a coach are targeted by a virtual kidnapping scheme.
text: Voice phishing, or vishing, is the use of telephony to conduct phishing attacks. Landline telephone services have traditionally been trustworthy: terminated in physical locations known to the telephone company and associated with a bill-payer.

title: Two Colombian migrants are shot dead by the National Guard near Tecate.
text: The National Guard is the national gendarmerie of Mexico, created in 2019 by absorbing units and officers from the Federal Police, Military Police, and Naval Police. In 2022, a reform package approved in the Mexican Congress transferred command of the National Guard to the Secretariat of National Defense.

text: The Mexican Navy is the maritime service branch of the Mexican Armed Forces. The Secretariat of the Navy is in charge of administration of the navy.

title: South Korea's Ministry of Unification confirms that the Arch of Reunification, a sculptural arch near Pyongyang, North Korea, has been demolished.
text: The Arch of Reunification, officially the Monument to the Three-Point Charter for National Reunification, was a sculptural arch located south of Pyongyang, the capital of North Korea. It was opened in August 2001 to commemorate Korean reunification proposals put forward by Kim Il Sung.

title: Opening of the 81st Whitney Biennial in New York City, United States, lasting until August 11, 2024.
text: The 2024 Whitney Biennial, titled Even Better than the Real Thing, is the 81st edition of the Whitney Museum's art biennial, hosted between March and August 2024.

title: Opening of the 60th Venice Biennale, lasting until November 24, 2024.
text: The 60th Venice Biennale was an international contemporary art exhibition held between April and November 2024 with the theme Foreigners Everywhere curated by Adriano Pedrosa as the artistic director. In addition, 88 countries contributed national pavilions.

title: A statue of Billy Graham, by Chas Fagan, is erected at the United States Capitol, in Washington, D.C.
text: A bronze statue of American evangelist Billy Graham is installed at the United States Capitol's crypt, in Washington, D.C., as part of the National Statuary Hall Collection. It was designed by artist Chas Fagan.
